node_7.subject: Chen Zian
node_7.description: This is Chen Zian's plan for Sunday February 15: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, review Confucian classics at his rented room from 8:00 am to 10:30 am, walk to the academy to consult with a teacher about essay structure from 10:30 am to 12:30 pm, have lunch at a tea house near the academy around 12:30 pm, browse poetry collections at a nearby bookshop from 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm, return home and practice composing a regulated verse poem from 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm, have a simple dinner, review his notes on recent court politics and policy debates from 8:00 pm to 9:30 pm.
